subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support allow `updateConfiguration` and explicit preview-field pass-through, and what default plus per-account semantics should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the default behavior, linked-device failure mode, and untrusted metadata boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in support
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields and documents primary-device limits before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the link-preview metadata boundary, then implement Signal config support.

options.title: Reject Signal preview config
options.body: Decline first-class Signal preview control in OpenClaw and leave operators to manage signal-cli preview behavior outside this repository.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in support
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields and documents primary-device limits before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already provided relevant public Signal implementation context on this issue.
